page.overview:
Who is Juni Dennick?

Juni Dennick was a character in The Graben Gang.

Juni was attempting to listen to her favorite shows on her Communinet Radio, but was unable to due to the noise her parents made as they attempted to mend the water recycler. Her mother Marika suggested that she listen to them outdoors and keep an ear out for wormsign. Her father stated that Sandworm activity had been up 9000% since Zantara took out the Shield Wall, leading Marika to ask how Zantara had done so in one day when it had taken Duv six months to build a shed. He resented being compared to an enemy of the Imperium, which Marika found to be an appealing idea for sexual roleplay, causing Juni to express her disgust at her parents before returning inside.
